SELECT sale_id, sale_name, sale_phone, lng, lat, address, createtime, updatetime FROM sale
AND sale_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{name}, '%')
ORDER BY sale_id DESC
SELECT sale_id, sale_name, sale_phone, lng, lat, address, createtime, updatetime FROM sale ORDER BY sale_id
SELECT sale_id, sale_name, sale_phone, lng, lat, address, createtime, updatetime FROM sale WHERE sale_id = #{saleId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sale (sale_name, sale_phone, lng, lat, address, createtime, updatetime) VALUES (#{saleName}, #{salePhone}, #{lng}, #{lat}, #{address}, #{createtime}, #{updatetime})
mapper.update: UPDATE sale SET sale_name = #{saleName}, sale_phone = #{salePhone}, lng = #{lng}, lat = #{lat}, address = #{address}, updatetime = #{updatetime} WHERE sale_id = #{saleId}
